en-US: Build 212 focuses on TinyEMU/Linux as the main local environment. Native Python and Node runtimes are archived and excluded from this app build; Python, Node, Shell and local services use the selected Linux environment. Download the updated Linux component from the list. Existing environment files and installed packages should survive the runner upgrade. Please test concurrent tasks and terminals, cancellation and recovery, then a local service. Also test Git initialization, local-model tool calls and compaction, cross-task history lookup through to a final answer, Notes assistant permissions, mind-map dragging and icon controls, Office editing/recovery and Chinese text, and PDF/Office tabs and workspace switching. This release uses focused checks and a cloud App build; device performance, crash resolution and real SSH/SCP transfers remain for your acceptance. An interpreter without JIT is not a guarantee of App Review approval.
zh-Hans: Build 212 重点改进 TinyEMU/Linux 主运行环境。原生 Python、Node 运行时已封存，本版不再打包；Python、Node、Shell 和本地服务使用选定的 Linux 环境。请从列表下载更新的 Linux 组件，并检查升级后原有文件和已安装包是否保留。请重点测试多个任务与终端同时运行、取消卡住的命令及恢复、启动本地服务。其余修复也请一并验收：Git 初始化；本地模型调用工具和压缩；跨任务查阅历史直到完成答复；手记助手权限；思维导图拖动与图标按钮；Office 编辑、恢复和中文；IDE 内 PDF/Office 标签及切换任务后的工作区。此次采用轻量检查与云端 App 构建，真机性能、闪退是否消失和真实 SSH/SCP 传输由你验收。
